per_article_summaries: Former F1 driver David Coulthard has backed George Russell for a comeback. Russell won the Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race. His Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli has won five consecutive grand prix races. Former F1 TV presenter Will Buxton disagreed with Coulthard.

Ferrari unveils latest aerodynamic upgrades ahead of Barcelona Grand Prix. The SF-26 has a revised nose with a raised lower surface. It also optimised its wing elements to improve the aero load distribution. Red Bull has changed its front wing geometry by revising existing parts.

Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has defended Kim Kardashian. The reality TV star was criticised for not speaking to Martin Brundle. Coulthard said Kardashian had been very polite to him on the grid. The 13-time grand prix winner added that it would be unfair to assume Kardashian knows the ins and outs of Formula 1.

The FIA have upheld Alpine's appeal against the Monaco Grand Prix results. Pierre Gasly's two five-second time penalties have been rescinded. Red Bull's Isack Hadjar has now lost his podium as a result. Lewis Hamilton, George Russell, Franco Colapinto and Oscar Piastri were also penalised for pitlane speeding.

Five drivers were penalised for pitlane speeding during the Monaco Grand Prix. Pierre Gasly received two separate five-second penalties that ultimately cost him a podium finish. Alpine has requested a Right of Review relating to his penalties. Stewards must now determine whether Gasly's two penalties should be revoked.

Formula 1's official television feed came under the scrutiny of fans during the first practice session for the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix. Seven-time MotoGP champion Marc Marquez was labelled as a former rider. The error immediately drew the attention of fans given Marquez's current MotoGP campaign as the reigning champion.

Pierre Gasly finished third at the 2026 Monaco Grand Prix on Friday. The Frenchman started the day in seventh place before ending it with a podium finish. He had been relegated to seventh place due to two penalties for speeding in the pitlane. Stewards of the Monaco GP ruled in favour of his team and concluded that the Frenchman had not committed any offence.

Pierre Gasly's podium reinstated after being given two five-second time penalties at the end of last Sunday's race for two separate speeding violations. A discrepancy in how pitlane speeds were measured at the entry of Monaco's unique pitlane meant Gasly and four other drivers were incorrectly found to be exceeding 60km/h limit.

Aston Martin picked up its first point of the season at the Monaco Grand Prix. Fernando Alonso finished 10th for the Lawrence Stroll-owned team. Sky Sports F1 commentator David Croft says the team have "little or nothing to celebrate" with earning a sole point.

McLaren and Red Bull are understood to have notified their intention to appeal against the FIA race stewards reinstating Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix podium. FIA stewards reinstated Gasly's podium after the Alpine driver was handed two five-second time penalties at the end of last Sunday's race for two separate speeding violations.

Fernando Alonso hints that this weekend's Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix will likely be his final race at the circuit. The Spaniard has not officially announced his retirement yet. Alonso picked up Aston Martin's first point of the 2026 season with a 10th-place finish at the Monaco Grand Prix.

Williams team principal James Vowles admits that the heavy damage sustained to Carlos Sainz's car during the Monaco Grand Prix will force the team to rebuild its stockpile of spare parts. The Spaniard was struck by Nico Hulkenberg and Franco Colapinto, resulting in his immediate retirement that robbed Williams of a double-points finish.

Max Verstappen says he understands the politics involved in F1 power unit changes. The Dutchman believes the changes are heading in the right direction. Fernando Alonso believes the DNA of the rules cannot be changed. The changes still need to be ratified by the FIA World Motor Sport Council.

Pierre Gasly has been restored to third place in the final results of the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix. Alpine successfully overturned his two pitlane speeding penalties in a right of review hearing. Here’s the FIA stewards report in full: The Stewards, having received two petitions for a Right of Review (Documents 73 and 75), having summoned (Documents 94, 95, 96 and 97) representatives of the following parties.

Pierre Gasly had originally crossed the finish line in third place in Monaco. He was later demoted to seventh after receiving two separate five-second penalties for allegedly exceeding the 60km/h pitlane speed limit. FIA stewards overturned both penalties on Friday after concluding that Gasly had not exceeded the speed limit on either occasion.

Jacques Villeneuve says Lewis Hamilton cannot beat Mercedes in a straight fight. Hamilton has enjoyed a resurgence at Ferrari with consecutive podiums in Canada and Monaco. The British driver has overtaken George Russell in the drivers' championship. Hamilton finished with the ninth-fastest time in second practice in Barcelona.

Saturday running begins with FP3, followed by qualifying for the Barcelona-Catalunya GP, which takes place on Sunday. Lando Norris and McLaren went fastest in FP2 ahead of George Russell for Mercedes. Hot conditions in practice caused serious tyre graining and marbling on some cars.

1997 Formula 1 champion Jacques Villeneuve believes George Russell's "smoother" driving style gives him an upper hand over his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. Russell was a clear favourite heading into the season, but Antonelli has surprised many with five consecutive wins. Villeneuve provided a technical breakdown to explain why the Spanish venue plays to Russell's strengths.

George Russell takes pole for Sunday's F1 Barcelona-Catalunya GP. Lewis Hamilton and Kimi Antonelli start on the front row. Sunday is expected to be hot and dry, with temperatures around 27°C. Sky Sports will broadcast every session live throughout the 2026 season.

George Russell claims he had a 'big reset' ahead of the Barcelona Grand Prix. The Mercedes driver started the season strongly by winning the Melbourne opener. But he has been outshone by team-mate Kimi Antonelli who has won the five grands prix.

Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has admitted that he remains cautious of the threat posed by seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton. Wolff said that when Hamilton is "in the right frame of mind and the car suits him, he is to be reckoned with" Hamilton will start tomorrow's Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix in P2.

Red Bull locked out the third row of the grid for Sunday’s Formula 1 Barcelona Grand Prix. Max Verstappen appeared to be in contention for pole position after two sectors, but saw his grip disappear in the last part of the lap. The Dutchman identified one other factor that made qualifying more complicated: the red flag caused by Charles Leclerc.

Charles Leclerc crashed in qualifying for the Barcelona Grand Prix. The Ferrari driver drifted onto the dustier line at Turn 4 and lost the back end. Leclerc is without a podium since Japan in March and crashed out from third at his home race in Monaco last weekend.

Fernando Alonso joked that he would rather watch the race from the grandstands than from his Aston Martin Formula 1 car. The two-time champion was taking part in the traditional pre-race drivers' parade at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. The 44-year-old started the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix from the pitlane.

Lewis Hamilton's first Ferrari win doesn't come out of nowhere. Kimi Antonelli also not immune to bad luck for the first time this season. Charles Leclerc faces a new challenge at Ferrari as Hamilton steps up. McLaren still has work to do to get back into the fight.

Ferrari's Kimi Antonelli retires with engine failure with three laps remaining. Team-mate George Russell finishes in second with Lando Norris in third. Lewis Hamilton wins for the first time in his 31st Ferrari start.

Oliver Bearman will start Sunday's Barcelona Grand Prix in 15th place. The Briton struggled with the Haas VF-26 in final practice on Saturday. The 21-year-old feared a Q1 exit after overnight car tweaks backfired. But he completed the joint-most laps in Q1 to progress into Q2.

Pirelli's tyre degradation figures for the Barcelona Grand Prix could be as high as two or three tenths. The asphalt at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya is among the roughest on the entire calendar. Different set-up choices and rim designs could play a major role in tyre degradation.

Kimi Antonelli suffered an engine failure at the Barcelona Grand Prix. The 19-year-old was running second behind Lewis Hamilton before retiring. Mercedes boss Toto Wolff has expressed concerns over the team's reliability. Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc also lost the power steering.
